benchmark.note: Synthetic random tokens; measures compute throughput only. Not a fidelity match to NeoX megatron packing.

extrapolations.assumption: Scale tokens/s linearly with micro_batch up to effective global batch 1024×2049 (Pythia); this bench used micro=2.
extrapolations.note: Real NeoX uses 32×A100 with microbatch 32/GPU (global 1024). Single-GPU float32 Adam here is a lower bound on tokens/s/GPU for costing; see docs/canary_design.md for budget table.
